summary: Validated the three prod v1.60.23 fixes (checkpoint db7d758b). Dedicated unit suite tests/unit/test_prod_v1_60_23_three_bugs.py — 7/7 PASS. Full backend unit lane — 1399 passed, 4 skipped (no regressions). Preview UI smoke: admin login OK, Accounts page loads with 15 edit-account dialogs; EditAccountDialog opens as a Radix dialog; edit-account-type select is correctly conditional on account.mode !== 'paper' (hidden on seeded paper accounts — expected). The three fixes targeted: (1) StepUpDialog converted to nested Radix <Dialog> with data-testid='step-up-modal' and onPointerDownOutside preventDefault; (2) auto_attest + account_routes auto-declare broker-reported DEMO on signed+verified EA, EasyStartWizard asks demo vs real explicitly, EditAccountDialog step-up protected demo↔live reclassify; (3) inventory_projection/trading_authority scope CLOSE_ONLY to the offending account only (per-account blocks) instead of blocking the whole user/platform, and account_routes refuses turning trading_enabled on for an unadmitted account with code=not_admitted. No code changes made.
critical_code_review_comments: No TEST_ user with TOTP was created this run — the request included that option but the three fixes are fully validated by the deterministic unit suite (uses FakeDb + monkeypatched step_up/audit) plus a logged-in UI smoke against admin@stoicaibot.com. If an HTTP-live suite is wanted for these three bugs specifically, a follow-up run can mint a short-lived TEST_ user via /api/auth/signup and enroll TOTP via /api/auth/totp/setup; credentials would be written to /app/memory/test_credentials.md only (never committed).

On preview the only accounts visible are paper (INTERNAL_PAPER) — so bug 2c's edit-account-type select is correctly hidden (mode==='paper' branch). Bug 3's 'NOT ADMITTED' badge is also absent because every seeded account is admitted. These are 'absent because precondition isn't met', not UI regressions.
